match_rules.native_pixels: SHA-256(width,height,grayscale uint8 pixels), decoded without resampling
match_rules.normalized_pixels: SHA-256 of 64x64 grayscale uint8 pixels after Pillow Lanczos; exact equality only

limits: Does not detect arbitrary crops, nearby video frames, or all re-encodings. Evidence covers the locally available release, not unknown upstream pretraining data. Membership audit only; no model predictions or test performance inspected.
